This is just if we follow uh the trends we have seen historically speaking bitcoin is starting to deviate a little bit from the drop that we saw back in in 2022 again patience is the biggest thing so that's all i got for you guys i appreciate you as always let me know your thoughts below but have a great day catch you guys in the next one take care
